sentences.text: Welcome to Video Flow!
Here, you can transform any text or document into an engaging MP4 video in minutes.
On the left, drop any PDF, Word doc, or paste your notes.

On the right, pick from five smart formats: Auto-Adaptive scales to your document length, Brief delivers quick summaries, Vertical Short creates mobile-ready clips for TikTok and Reels, while Explainer and Cinematic create comprehensive visual breakdowns.
Next, let's look at AI engines and API keys!
NotebookLM works with just your Google login; add an API key only if you want the built-in engine.
Step 3 is your Video Library.
Every video you create across your desktop or from this studio is saved right here.
You can filter by status, search past projects, and preview chapters.
When a video is ready, download the full HD MP4 file with a single click.
Next, let's see how to trigger Video Flow directly from your screen!
Finally, Video Flow works seamlessly everywhere across Windows.
Whenever you are reading an article on Twitter, browsing in Chrome, or reviewing a document, highlight any text and trigger the floating shortcut.
Video Flow generates and renders your video in the background while you keep working.
You're now ready to create your first video.
Click Get Started to begin!
